mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is an inducer of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) enzymes, which may increase abacavir metabolism and reduce its antiviral exposure.
action: Monitor abacavir efficacy and viral load; consider alternative antiretroviral if virological failure occurs; HLA-B*5701 screening should be confirmed prior to abacavir use regardless of eslicarbazepine co-administration.
